evidence: swift build passed and the current DiskStewardApp executable launched under its accessory UI smoke entry path.
All increment-one behaviors re-ran in the 54-test suite: current volume capacity, menu-bar routing/labels, rendered status board, schema-valid deterministic snapshot export, and privacy contract.

The independent temporary-fixture scenario moved from baseline through watched-root growth, inferred detailed evidence, outside-root unknown explanation, threshold crossing, SQLite persistence, complete export, and process-object restart/reopen recovery.

The integrated export decoded its manifest, recomputed every payload byte length and SHA-256 hash, and its brief named agent-growth.bin, inferred snapshot-delta attribution, and the no-content/no-environment privacy guarantee.

The reopened evidence database returned integrity ok, retained at least three snapshots and one detailed event, and remained below the test's 10 MiB hard ceiling. Raw export and monitor scans retain their independent count/depth/time bounds.

The visually inspected 330×270 current popover fit state, explanation, growth baseline, capacity, pause, refresh, and export controls; accessibility summaries and degraded/recovered copy are automated separately.

The measured launch smoke completed in 0.37 seconds with about 28.0 MiB maximum RSS, about 9.9 MiB peak footprint, zero swaps, and zero block I/O; evidence explicitly limits this claim to launch-path behavior.
